result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading spinner remains visible over an already loaded restaurant card image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner overlay is stuck in the middle of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card image under 'Popular right now', even though the image and card details have already finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator state is properly dismissed and hidden once the image or feed content has completed rendering.
